items.lede: Japanese gaming giant Capcom has confirmed that hackers breached its membership service, CAPCOM ID, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information. [...]
items.title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts

items.lede: Capcom ID is still available to use, but users may see more phishing scam emails.
items.title: Capcom confirms data breach that affected 11.7 million users
